name: DUMBBELL DRAG CURLS
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward. \n\nPull your elbows back and lift the dumbbells to your chest height. Slowly lower the dumbbells and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your arms close to your body.
Exhale as you lift the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
